title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.00 (quiet) at 07:00 UTC on 9 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 9 日 07:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 1.00 (1Z) at 07:00 UTC on 9 October 2026. The 07 hour is complete (60 samples through 07:59; hour-start 1.00/1Z, hour-end 1.67/2M). Last-180 maximum is 2.67 (first at 2026-10-09T05:59:00Z; label 3M). Published-window maximum is 3.00 (first at 2026-10-09T05:13:00Z; label 3Z). Window starts 2026-10-09T03:01:00Z (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 3.00. The 08 UTC hour on 9 October is incomplete (59 samples through 08:58).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
